# mimecast_profile_group_member (Resource)

Manage membership of a user email address or domain in a Mimecast profile group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_profile_group_member" "alice" {
  group_id      = mimecast_profile_group.engineering.id
  email_address = "alice@example.com"
  note          = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Profile group ID.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Member domain. Use either domain or email_address.
- `email_address` (String) Member email address. Use either email_address or domain.
- `note` (String) Optional note when adding the member.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the form `group_id/member`.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the member is internal.
- `name` (String) Member display name returned by Mimecast.
- `type` (String) Address type returned by Mimecast.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_profile_group_member.alice group-id/alice@example.com
```
